label: PRE-REGISTERED expectations for GATE ROUND ONE on the F5 set (F5a backlog units, F5b state value, F5c deficit routing, with B1, F2 and F3 on), committed BEFORE any F5 commit was run against them. Existing Part 2 and v1.2 expectations are untouched.

G1a_dashcam_axis.expect_detail: after F5a, policy-core releases a dashcam-instant fraction at or above edf at EVERY size in 4, 8, 16, 32. The before-ground I measured is the number this is judged against
G1a_dashcam_axis.justification: the user judges a units mismatch between accumulated GPU-seconds and a wall-clock horizon the likely explanation of F-A7 and S2; if that is right, correcting the units should remove the dashcam deficit, since nothing else about the dashcam path changes
G1a_dashcam_axis.falsifier: if the dashcam fraction does not move at all, the units were already consistent and F-A7 has another cause

G1b_backlog_magnitude.expect_detail: the p50 absolute backlog charge on state_promote_rebuild falls below the 1.084 I measured, and the ratio of that charge to the largest available benefit (0.035 continuation, 0.083 RC utility) falls below the 31x and 13x I measured
G1b_backlog_magnitude.justification: if the term was comparing GPU-seconds against a wall-clock horizon it was inflated by the batching factor; correcting the units should shrink it. F-A6 is NOT adopted as a tuning change, so this ratio may only move through the units fix
G1b_backlog_magnitude.falsifier: the ratio is unchanged, in which case the exchange rate stands as measured and v1.2 long-window structure is the only remaining route

G1c_state_value_zero_fraction.expect_detail: the exactly-zero fraction of the state-value channel falls strictly below 1.0 for at least piece_release and state_promote_rebuild, measured over the SAME candidate population as my F-A2 baseline of 1.0 across all 124,354 candidates
G1c_state_value_zero_fraction.justification: F5b wires the KV and host-tier bookkeeping into the terminal state value so a candidate that evicts or keeps a history changes its value; if the fraction stays at exactly 1.0 the wiring did not reach the term
G1c_state_value_zero_fraction.falsifier: the fraction stays 1.0, which would mean F5b did not land in the path the audit measures

G1d_blind_spot_F_A1.expect_detail: for piece_release and state_promote_rebuild, at least one of the benefit channels (rc_util, cont, z, sv) has an exactly-zero fraction strictly below 0.99, against my baseline where all four were at or above 0.999
G1d_blind_spot_F_A1.justification: F-A1 is the finding that every benefit channel was dead while both cost channels were live; this is its direct re-test on identical ground
G1d_blind_spot_F_A1.falsifier: all four remain at or above 0.99, so the decision is still assembled from live costs and dead benefits

G1e_deficit_routing_identical.expect_detail: decisions are byte-identical before and after F5c with B1 on, since the ruling states behaviour should be unchanged
G1e_deficit_routing_identical.justification: F5c is a routing change through Coordinator.update_deficit, the entry point spec_map.py names; it is not meant to change any value
G1e_deficit_routing_identical.falsifier: any decision differs, which would mean the routing changed behaviour and not only the call path

G1f_robot_axis.target: the F5 set as a whole
G1f_robot_axis.expect_detail: the robot measure is REPORTED against the best baseline at every size. No threshold is pre-registered for round one, because D126 states explicitly that F5 may repair the dashcam axis while robots still fail, and that this is worth reporting either way
G1f_robot_axis.justification: pre-registering a robot threshold for round one would invent a bar the ruling does not set; v1.2 long window is the intended structural answer for robots

before_ground.note: the audit is re-run on the SAME candidate population so before and after sit on identical ground, as D126 requires
before_ground.F_A1: for piece_release and state_promote_rebuild, exactly-zero fractions were rc_util 0.999 and 1.000, cont 0.999 and 0.999, z 1.0 and 1.0, sv 1.0 and 1.0, while backlog moved in 88 and 80 percent of candidates
before_ground.F_A2: state value exactly zero in 1.0 of candidates for every kind, across 124,354 candidates at 4, 8 and 16 fleet devices and the 32-device synthetic fixture
before_ground.F_A6: p50 absolute backlog charge on state_promote_rebuild 1.084, p90 2.071, against a largest continuation credit of 0.035 and a largest RC utility of 0.083, so 31x and 13x
before_ground.F_A7: dashcam released fraction, policy-core v1.0 0.999, 0.487, 0.075 at 4, 8, 16 against edf 0.999, 0.999, 0.626; v1.1 0.978, 0.927, 0.449

gate_rounds.round_one: the F5 set: pass/fail per scenario plus the comparison at 4, 8, 16 and 32 on BOTH axes
gate_rounds.round_two: v1.2 and the six ablations, with the v1.2 scenarios already pre-registered in v12_scenario_preregistration.json

pass_string_discipline: the commit message starting "harden GATE PASS v1.2" is emitted ONLY if a round passes BOTH halves, never for a partial pass such as the dashcam axis alone
f_a6_status: NOT ADOPTED per D126; the exchange rate stays as it is, so the 31x and 13x ratios may only move through the F5a units correction, and are judged on measurement

G1a_dashcam_axis.evidence: session 1 V20 refutes the units hypothesis from the spec side (mu is utility per GPU-second, busy sums pr.gpu_s); independently, my F3 before-ground drove the promote-rebuild backlog p50 from 1.084 to 0.0 with NO change in the dashcam fraction (0.487 and 0.075 unchanged)
G1a_dashcam_axis.conclusion: F-A7 has another cause, named in F-A8: the SH admission test

G1b_backlog_magnitude.conclusion: the exchange rate stands as measured; v1.2 long-window structure is the only remaining route for recall, and nothing queued addresses SH

G1d_blind_spot_F_A1.status: OPEN, testable when F5a and F5b land

G1f_robot_axis.status: REPORTED, no threshold pre-registered for round one

F_A8.finding: the measured cause of F-A7 is the SH admission test, not the backlog units
F_A8.agreement: exact to three digits at every size, identical with all switches off and with the F3 set on
F_A8.why: sh_admit own gain p50 0.055 against a backlog charge p50 0.205, so one instant gain is about a quarter of the price its own work is charged
F_A8.gate_consequence: nothing currently queued addresses SH admission: F5a refuted, F5b unrelated, F5c byte-identical by intent, v1.2 RC-only with SH unchanged, and F-A6 not adopted; so the dashcam half of the D127 gate cannot pass at 8, 16 or 32 devices on current plans
